name: Sengoku house names: Takeda sees the generic names

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); if PlayerConfigurations[0]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~='CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA' then error('setup changed the human player') end; HideGameSetup(); return 'setup built like Create Game'

if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; if PlayerConfigurations[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~='CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA' then error('wrong local house') end; return 'local house CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA'

local house=false; local id='CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TAIKO_LAND_SURVEY'; local g='LOC_CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TAIKO_LAND_SURVEY_NAME'; local h=g..'_HOUSE'; local c=GameInfo.Civics[id]; if c.Name~=g then error('database name is not the generic tag: '..tostring(c.Name)) end; local hs=Locale.Lookup(h); if hs=='' or hs==h then error('house text missing') end; local shown=Locale.Lookup(c.Name); if shown==g then error('generic text missing') end; local blurb=Locale.Lookup('LOC_UI_CIVIC_PROGRESS_COMPLETE_BLURB',c.Name); local has=function(s,t) return string.find(s,t,1,true)~=nil end; if house then if shown~=hs then error('expected house name '..hs..' got '..shown) end; if not has(blurb,hs) then error('format argument not switched: '..blurb) end; if Locale.ToUpper(c.Name)~=Locale.ToUpper(hs) then error('ToUpper not switched') end else if shown==hs or has(blurb,hs) then error('house name leaked to '..PlayerConfigurations[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()..': '..shown) end end; local era=Locale.Lookup(GameInfo.Eras['ERA_MEDIEVAL'].Name); local eh=Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_SENGOKU_ERA_3_NAME_HOUSE'); if house and era~=eh then error('era name not switched: '..era) end; if not house and era==eh then error('era house name leaked: '..era) end; local tip=ToolTipHelper.GetToolTip(id,Game.GetLocalPlayer()) or ''; if house and not (has(tip,hs) or has(tip,Locale.ToUpper(hs))) then error('tooltip not switched') end; if not house and (has(tip,hs) or has(tip,Locale.ToUpper(hs))) then error('tooltip leaked') end; print('[JAC_HOUSE] state=TechTree local='..PlayerConfigurations[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()..' civic='..shown..' era='..era); return shown
